title: IVG Intense Salts Fizzy Cherry 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: IVG Intense Salts Fizzy Cherry delivers the juicy sweetness of ripe Cherries with a sparkling fizz that lifts the flavour. The combination balances rich fruit with a playful soda-style edge. Blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, this Nic Salt e-liquid ensures clear flavour delivery, discreet vapour production, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Fizzy Cherry is well suited to mouth-to-lung (MTL) pod kits, starter kits, and vape pens. Part of the IVG Intense Salts range, Fizzy Cherry offers a drink-inspired twist on a classic fruit flavour.
